In particular, her late-charge closing speed was razor-sharp, like the holy blade of the hero Roland.
She was a formidable rival whom none could best, but...
OOOOOOOOOOHHH!!

It looked as if she had exceeded the top speed achievable by an Umamusume. Just
how fast was she going? I decided to run a simulation.

This is it. The speed when she caught that purse-snatcher was
exactly like this. As for her opponent in the race—

I was just as utterly stunned by that speed.
Her electrifying run—was still burned into my mind even now.

Ah, so frustrating! It is far too frustrating!
To think it would end in such a result.

I see... It looks like we'll get to see her full strength today.
Because her opponent is *that* Umamusume, after all.

Sudden burst of acceleration—straight into top speed.
That running style... was nothing short of miraculous.

Calstone Light O 
WIN!

I am not concerned about victory or defeat.
More than that, my lingering regret is...

Pronghorn 
WIN!

If she truly wished to defeat Durandal no matter what,
I wanted to lend her my strength by all means possible.

Her frustration wasn't over losing, but over a lack of speed... Calstone Light O's
fixation seemed completely different from any ordinary Umamusume's.

Not reaching my maximum velocity!
I could have gone faster! Flown further! Fast enough to float in midair!!

She resolutely blocked the purse snatcher's path.
The contest of top speed against the motorcycle ended in Calstone Light O's victory.

Subjected to a relentless, rapid-fire lecture... the purse snatcher simply
stood dumbfounded, unable to process the fact that he had been caught on foot.
!? That initial burst of speed is...!!
What on earth are you talking about?

She was putting up terrifying figures...
No Umamusume past or present could ever match such speed.

Her race tactics and cornering still have plenty of room to improve.
If only she would let me advise her...

Quietly munch on your deer crackers like a good boy!
Haaaaaaah!

Kh... Faster. I can go faster!
Faasteeeerrrr!!

I should have reached a higher top speed!!
So... why didn't I...!?
This is the end of the line. Give up!

It was a replay of that day. The reenactment of that flash of lightning
that overtook even a motorcycle. And yet—

—? 
You're... that Trainer from the other day...
Kuuugh...! Kh!
And when I looked at the estimated speed value—
Wait, beat Durandal...?

The pronghorn. Also known as the pronghorn antelope.
I took a chance and pitted her against the animal kingdom's second-fastest powerhouse.

Calstone Light O 
WIN!

Should you run devoid of pride—I shall merely cut you down.
Become the tarnish upon my Holy Sword.
VS Elephant!

An opening! Fourth Sword: Dionysus's Thunder Halberd!
Yaaaaahhhhhhhhhhhhhh!!

—Durandal. A gifted sprint Umamusume
who conducts herself like a medieval knight.

Hmph, an elephant? I may lose in trunk length, but never in running!
Haaaaah!!

Durandal...
To think I'd run into her in such a crucial bout.

Impossible!? She caught up to a motorcycle!?
And not a moped either, this is a full 250cc bike...
Though they ran neck-and-neck for a brief moment...

Snatching purses is a crime! When you steal a bag, the owner loses it.
Losing it causes them trouble. Apologize at once!

Next up is a deer.
A deer's speed should be surmountable by certain Umamusume, but...

Calstone Light O may indeed be an eccentric.
However, her passion for racing is the real deal.

W-What!? This speed...!?
Found you, my worthy rival! Haaaaaaah!!

Though defeated, winning wasn't out of the realm of possibility.
Doing it all alone might be her limit, but...

—No, it was nothing.
I'm truly glad you're all right.

Kh, a corner...? And counterclockwise, my weak point...
At this speed, I won't...!

Shall we settle this in earnest combat, then?
Light O-san, do you possess the resolve to take the field of battle?
VS Deer!

The pronghorn won. But it was close!
Calstone Light O's maximum speed is comparable to third place among all land animals!

You have my deepest gratitude for this fiercely contested clash.
Yet there is nothing my Holy Sword cannot cleave.
Haaaaaaah!!

She pulled away effortlessly. She really is in a whole different league from normal Umamusume.
If that's how it is—
Haaaaaaaah!!
VS Pronghorn!

Calstone Light O doggedly held on with all her might.
However, that was as far as she could go.

First, I entered a rough estimate of the speed I witnessed.
Then, I decided to test her against a variety of opponents.

I booted up the VR Umalator, a virtual reality device.
There was something I absolutely had to verify using this full-fledged simulator.

An ordinary Umamusume could outrun animals in this tier.
The next rival is—

My excitement wouldn't settle down. The passion burning within me as a Trainer
could no longer be held back.

...Oh? You're the Trainer from the other day.
Are you here... to observe the Debut Race?
—That evening, in the gymnasium.

Kh, pathetic...
How could this...
